content:
alex: Hey - ACME-Ride reported a stream stopped mid-response. They got a partial JSON (truncated) and the client retried; customer says they were billed twice.
maya: Which request id?
alex: req id: r-0a9c3e. Event time 2026-03-12T17:03:12Z. Edge logs show 502 then a client-side reconnect.
ivan: Can you paste the client's curl/headers so we can repro?
alex: Sending their repro snippet:
```
curl --no-buffer -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=rwd-13b" 
```
alex: They say it happens mostly when switching from wifi -> mobile hotspot.
maya: Sounds like TCP RST on NAT refresh. Mobile handoff often causes socket half-close and the app retries, resulting in duplicate partial outputs.
ivan: Also check token rotation TTL. If token refresh happens mid-stream and client opens a new connection, billing might count both segments.
alex: LB logs:
- upstream reset by peer
- websocket: client_closed
- responder: stream_chunked_write_error
maya: That's consistent with abrupt client close. On iOS background handoffs we saw identical traces earlier.
ivan: Short repro: put phone on wifi, start SSE, then flip to hotspot. Repro rate ~70% on our test app.
sre-oncall: Quick mitigation for customer: enable client-side dedupe (use Last-Event-ID or attach session id) and exponential backoff. Also set keepalive pings. :thumbsup:
alex: Sent mitigation steps to customer + asked for pcap + app logs. Also requested their SDK version.
finance: FYI billing flagged — if two partial streams were billed, we'll need records to credit. Customer waiting.
maya: Engineering note: we should make streaming billing idempotent based on stream_id when possible.
ivan: I'll open an eng issue to add server-side resume support (idempotent chunk IDs) and token-rotation guidance.
alex: Filed support ticket S-4219 and eng bug RWD-9876. Putting customer on priority support. I'll update thread when we get pcap.
support-bot: Ticket S-4219 created and linked to RWD-9876.
alex: thanks everyone. Closing loop with customer in 30m window.
